decision: Each landing zone has its own parameter file and dedicated trigger workflow.
why: Acting on one landing zone would risk triggering another team's redeployment.

links.note: Without the platform member profile, the bicepparam file has no initial values to populate.
Without the reusable workflow, per landing-zone triggers cannot share centralized deployment logic.
Without the app registration's credentials, the template cannot deploy landing zone resources.
Without the application repo, environment-scoped variables have no destination after provisioning.

violations: Generated workflow name not matching lz-* prefix — breaks fan-out discovery.
